verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for an identity-verification SaaS that holds sensitive ID documents, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data-residency controls for Stripe Identity. The items cover verification flows, access to results, webhooks, sandboxes and versioning, none of which address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
